Time to Support Yogi Ji!


“So, vote for a party that votes politics out of governance.”


Samajwadi Party and its political ecosystem have long relied on caste-based politics. In my view, this politics has done little to genuinely empower the very communities it claims to represent, particularly the PDA (Backward, SC and ST) communities.

A politics that keeps communities dependent on identity-based mobilisation cannot be the path to lasting empowerment.

The real alternative is governance that moves beyond caste calculations, where development, law and order, opportunity and equal citizenship take precedence over vote-bank politics.

If you want politics to stop dictating governance, support the leadership that seeks to put governance before vote-bank calculations.
